name: Cua um
summary: Cua um chua ngọt is a sour-sweet crab braise.
howToEat: Order it at lunch or dinner.
Cua hai da is printed at 750,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. That figure is the live crab, not a printed price for the braise.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ.
